offering_description.value: Makes and sells branded candy, including chewy candies, lollipops, mints and gum, to grocery, mass merchandise, drugstore and convenience store retailers. Products are made in company-owned plants and sold through direct sales staff, brokers and distributors.

primary_products.value: chewy candies; lollipops; mints; gum; chocolate-covered cherries

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery chains, mass merchandisers, drugstores, dollar stores, convenience stores, wholesale clubs, distributors

end_markets.value: retail grocery; mass merchandise; convenience stores; foodservice

revenue_model.value: product sales: candy sold to retailers, wholesale distributors and foodservice buyers; rental or leasing: rent from a small portfolio of investment real estate

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes candy in its own plants from purchased sugar, corn syrup and other ingredients, sold to retailers and distributors; brand owner: owns its candy brands and sells them to retail and foodservice customers

geography_served.value: North America: primarily US national, also Canada and Mexico, with some exports to other countries

specialization.value: related lines: chewy candies, lollipops, mints and gum sold through the same retail channels, minor real estate holdings

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff calling on national grocery and mass merchant chains; distributors / dealers: wholesale and foodservice distributors; agents / brokers: independent brokers selling to retail accounts
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food safety, labeling and facility rules for candy manufacturing
